patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks are used, often with a large, visually dominant element like the invitation card, balanced by text columns or empty space.

A strong typographic contrast is established between elegant, decorative script fonts for primary titles and clean, legible sans-serifs for body text and functional labels, with frequent use of uppercase for subheadings and labels.
A sophisticated, muted color palette of deep forest green, warm blush pink, and creamy off-white is consistently applied across sections, accented with a rich, antique gold/bronze.

A sticky header with navigation and an RSVP button appears and fixes to the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero content. A large invitation card reveals itself with a subtle upward slide and fade as its section enters the viewport.
Distinct content sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes or background images, creating a structured yet fluid visual flow down the page.

technique_notes: A sticky header is implemented to appear and fix to the top of the viewport only after the user scrolls beyond the initial hero content, providing persistent navigation.
Background images are set to scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect that adds depth to the page.
Key content blocks, such as the prominent invitation card, are designed to animate into view with a gentle fade and slight upward translation as the user scrolls into their respective sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant script display headings are very large and decorative, contrasted with small to medium-sized, clean sans-serif body text and tiny, uppercase sans-serif labels, often separated by fine lines.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements, with very subtle rounding on buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within text blocks, creating a sense of calm and elegance.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated, invitation-inspired aesthetic, blending elegant script typography and ornate graphic elements with a muted, luxurious color palette. The design effectively translates the tactile feel of a high-end physical invitation into a digital experience, creating a distinctive and memorable brand identity for a personal event.
